en.title: Gelato at Higashine's "Yotteke Popola" — Gelato Made with Honbo Honey
en.summary: A gelato shop inside Yotteke Popola in Higashine City. The start of sales of a gelato made with Honbo honey is introduced.
en.html:
This is a gelato shop inside Yotteke Popola in Higashine City.

A Threads post (@honbouganji) introduces the start of sales of a gelato made with Honbo honey. The staff developed it through trial and error, and the poster says it was "very delicious."

Shop Information (from the post)

  • Location: Yotteke Popola (Higashine City)
  • Shop Name: Not specified in the post — please check (a gelato shop inside Yotteke Popola)
  • Specialties: Gelato made with Honbo honey

Source

  • Threads post (@honbouganji): https://www.threads.com/@honbouganji/post/DfBaoGgoPY9
  • Business hours, sales periods, and other details may change. Please check with the shop for the latest information.

東根市のよってけポポラ内にあるジェラート屋さんです。

Threads の投稿（@honbouganji）では、本坊蜂蜜を使ったジェラートが販売されると紹介されています。店員さんたちが試行錯誤して開発したとのことで、投稿者も「とっても美味しかった」と伝えています。
